MASTER-OAFA robotic telescope  [1]  located in Argentina (OAFA observatory of San Juan National University) was pointed to the IceCube Alert 260709A (trigger No 7869742,19h 31m 14.40s , -15d 10m 12.0s, R=0.47) errorbox  26953 sec after notice time and 27118 sec after trigger time at 2026-07-09 00:49:40 UT, with upper limit up to  19.4 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 59 deg. The sun  altitude  is -38.3 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -16 deg., longitude l = 24 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3421037
